prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1110; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating, consistent with a concussion. Neurological examination on initial presentation showed no focal deficits, and cognitive screening revealed mild impairment in attention and processing speed. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical decision rules.

Over the course of care, the patient attended 29 visits. Treatment focused on graded physical and cognitive rest, followed by a progressive return-to-activity plan. Vestibular and oculomotor therapy was introduced to address persistent dizziness and visual tracking difficulty. Symptom scores were tracked at each visit and showed steady improvement over the treatment period, with headaches becoming less frequent and cognitive endurance gradually returning to baseline.

At discharge, the patient was largely asymptomatic at rest and tolerating full work and daily activities. Residual mild sensitivity to bright environments was noted and monitored. Follow-up was recommended as needed, with instructions to return promptly for any recurrence of severe headache, confusion, or worsening symptoms.
